purpose.en: Establish the facts before designing or discussing bounded requirements.
purpose.zh: 先查清事实，再设计和讨论有明确边界的需求。

owner.zh: 调查负责人、维护者与设计者

steps.en: Consolidate evidence and resolve discoverable gaps
steps.zh: 汇总证据，补齐可查缺口

steps.en: Record decisions and hand the baseline to the Designer
steps.zh: 记录决定，将依据交给 Designer

exit.en: Investigation is consolidated and material decisions for dependent design are resolved.
exit.zh: 调查已汇总，依赖的重要设计决策已确定。

failure.en: Investigate facts and alternatives; pause only dependent work.
failure.zh: 查清事实和选项，只暂停依赖该决定的工作。

boundary.en: Complete investigation before planning, Designer dispatch, requirements discussion or edits. Independent investigations may run in parallel; dependent design may not. A proposal or silence is not approval.
boundary.zh: 调查完成后才能写计划、派 Designer、讨论需求或修改。独立调查可并行，依赖它的设计不可提前；提案和沉默不表示同意。
